summary.text: Jana Hunt is a Republican state representative from District 28A who took office in January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a nurse and rancher.

paragraphs.text: Jana Hunt was born in Dupree, South Dakota, and her career experience includes working as a traveling nurse and rancher, according to Ballotpedia.
She assumed office in the South Dakota House of Representatives on January 14, 2025, and serves on the House Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee and the House Judiciary Committee.
